import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
py='/home/leonh/prediction_research_prod/.venv/bin/python'
root=Path.cwd()
base=['-m','pytest','-q','-o','log_file=']
stages=[
 ('TARGETED',base+['tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py']),
 ('WIRING',base+['tests/codex_supervisor/test_autobuild_runtime_wiring_e004i.py']),
 ('FULL',base+['tests']),
]
for label,args in stages:
 cp=subprocess.run([py,*args],cwd=root,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 out=cp.stdout or ''
 if cp.returncode!=0:
  compact=' | '.join(x.strip() for x in out.splitlines()[-16:] if x.strip())[:2200]
  raise SystemExit('TEST_FAIL_'+label+'='+compact)
 print(label+'_PASS '+(' | '.join(x.strip() for x in out.splitlines()[-4:] if x.strip())[:700]))

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
want={'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py','knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json'}
cp=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=Path.cwd(),text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert cp.returncode==0,'CACHED_DIFF_FAILED:'+cp.stdout[-500:]
got={x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()}
assert got==want,'STAGED_SET_MISMATCH:'+repr(sorted(got))
print('STAGED_SET_EXACT')
